title: Quenching the thirst internally: separating miRNA from target mRNA by condensation of AGO1
content: Water is essential for the survival of terrestrial plants, and dehydration triggers stress responses in them. Prolonged dehydration, such as drought, can be detrimental to growth and survival. Adaptive strategies, such as physiological, metabolic, and gene expression changes are often deployed by plants to cope with dehydration (Blum and Tuberosa 2018).
